acceptance_tests.name: polarity_contract_preserved
acceptance_tests.requirement: positive model value must still mean `converter_positive_input_is_negative_raw_preamp_output_diff` at the latch/SAR boundary

acceptance_tests.name: both_signs_resolve
acceptance_tests.requirement: positive and negative target-edge cases must both resolve to full latch output with the contracted sign

acceptance_tests.name: kickback_hard_line
acceptance_tests.requirement: worst sampled-node differential kickback must be <= 2.197265625e-04 V

acceptance_tests.name: kickback_design_target
acceptance_tests.requirement: preferred target is <= 1.098632813e-04 V, giving half-LSB slack for offset and noise

acceptance_tests.name: margin_survives_isolation
acceptance_tests.requirement: corrected pre-latch output must stay >= 5.000000000e-04 V for both signs after isolation is added

acceptance_tests.name: wrong_code_proxy
acceptance_tests.requirement: the measured sign at the SAR threshold must not flip after applying offset, noise, and kickback budgets

acceptance_tests.name: no_strict_claim
acceptance_tests.requirement: candidate_post_layout_written=false and accepted_post_layout_written=false until extracted same-run evidence exists

candidate_moves.main_risk: buffer offset and bias current can eat the 0.5 mV margin
candidate_moves.name: source_follower_input_buffer
candidate_moves.what_changes: the transistor handoff drives a small buffer gate; the latch reads the buffer output
candidate_moves.why_it_might_work: the held analog node sees less clocked latch capacitance

candidate_moves.main_risk: the extra sampling action adds charge injection and timing error
candidate_moves.name: sampled_internal_decision_capacitor
candidate_moves.what_changes: copy the polarity-corrected preamp value onto a small internal capacitor, then disconnect the frontend before latch regeneration
candidate_moves.why_it_might_work: kickback lands mostly on the internal decision node instead of the frontend sense node

candidate_moves.main_risk: preamp noise, offset, and energy become part of the converter budget
candidate_moves.name: two_phase_preamp_then_latch
candidate_moves.what_changes: first amplify the polarity-named signal, then enable the latch after the preamp output is settled
candidate_moves.why_it_might_work: the latch sees a larger internal difference and can use smaller input devices

candidate_moves.main_risk: timing can hide kickback in a later phase unless both before and after values are measured
candidate_moves.name: delayed_or_bottom_plate_latch_clock
candidate_moves.what_changes: delay the regenerative clock edge until the sampled handoff nodes are isolated
candidate_moves.why_it_might_work: clock feedthrough is separated from the moment when the analog value is being stored

claim_boundary.allowed: turns the polarity contract and measured latch kickback failure into the next isolated-latch circuit work order
claim_boundary.not_allowed: does not prove the isolated latch circuit, SAR bit cycling, noise, offset statistics, extracted layout, DRC/LVS, or accepted post-layout converter evidence

next_executable_step: build a small ngspice fixture that inserts one isolation move between the polarity-corrected transistor preamp output and the clocked latch input
